caption: The drawing features a single clear glass object positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The object consists of a round, bulbous upper section with a short, narrow neck at the top, which appears slightly open. Below the bulb, a slender, straight stem connects it to a broader, circular base. The base is detailed with a ridged or grooved texture on its outer edge. The shading and reflections on the glass suggest a translucent, reflective material. In the lower right corner, the name "John Tarantino" is written in small, neat letters. In the lower left corner, a small, simple scale bar is visible.
title: Spark Lamp
